summary: Accepted ADR for AI posture and weak-model agent design. BYOK first with Anthropic, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Gemini, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint covering Ollama LM Studio koboldcpp for local; no Vaudeville-operated inference, no account, no proxy; keys in local vault OS keychain or encrypted file. AI is optional: Converter, inspection, validation, deterministic Doctor checks, and project management work with zero keys; first key ask is at first AI moment never at install. Agent must survive weak models using Orison lessons: tiny always-on tools with deferred schemas, resource verbs over vaud URIs, prompted XML tool-calling fallback one tool per iteration, spill store for big results, explicit samplers, staged edits with validate-before-commit never writing user files directly. Model roles are user-mappable per interview treatment test-stage and bulk audits with a sane single-model default. Eval harness at M2 before agent feature work with golden tasks replayable transcripts and model matrix requiring success-rate and tokens-per-task movement. Why: local-first BYOK matches privacy pitch and audience that owns keys; weak-model constraints also make frontier behavior cheaper and more reliable.

sections.title: Why
sections.summary: Local-first plus BYOK is the only stance consistent with the privacy pitch and with an audience that already owns keys and local rigs. Weak-model constraints are not charity: they make frontier-model behavior cheaper and more reliable too, which is Orison's measured lesson.
